title: Jellies
description: A sea nettle and a few moon jellies drift through dark water under light from the surface. Every bell, oral arm and tentacle is translucent and drawn in any order: the passes add them into accumulation and revealage targets, and one composite lays the result over the water. Each bell pulses on its own rhythm, and kernels pull its tentacles and arms behind it as follow-the-leader chains. Drag to stir the water. Tap a jelly to make it contract, dart away and flash. Marine snow, bubbles, bloom and the final pass finish the tank.
line: Translucent jellies in any draw order; tap one and it flashes.
hint: drag to stir · tap a jelly to startle it
